authority_note: Use this file as the controlling source for publishable facts and quotations.

pilot.comparison_basis: the six weeks immediately before the pilot versus the six-week pilot

results.metric: median active scheduling time per work order

results.qualification: The six-week window is too short to separate the change from seasonal demand. Do not call this conclusive.

pilot.adoption_signal: 11 of 14 coordinators used saved windows on at least four days per week during the final two weeks.
limitations: The pilot covered three branches of one residential maintenance operator.
Northstar did not run a randomized control group.
No employee-hours-saved or revenue claim has been approved.

workflow.before: Coordinators kept branch-specific promise windows in spreadsheets and relayed changes in chat; dispatchers rebuilt routes after late jobs or absences.
workflow.with_product: Coordinators save customer promise windows on each work order. Dispatchers can see which windows still have slack before moving a job, and technicians receive the updated sequence in the existing mobile view.
workflow.scope_note: Dispatch Windows recommends feasible moves but does not automatically reassign a technician or contact a customer.

launch_targets: sustain at least a 25% reduction in median active scheduling time per work order
launch.approved_cta: Bring one week of after-hours reassignments to a Northstar workflow review.
